# Kiln

> Kiln is a rules-exact Magic: The Gathering engine (Commander-first, N players) with a simulation lab: give it decklists and an experiment spec, and it plays thousands of games and reports win rates with 95% confidence intervals, game shape, mulligans, per-card statistics, A/B comparisons and validity warnings. Agents drive it through an MCP server (`kiln mcp serve`) or the `kiln` CLI with `--json`.

## Start here

- [Agent guide](docs/agents/AGENT_GUIDE.md): setup, the deck-evaluation walkthrough, reading results, writing playbooks, pitfalls
- [MCP tools](docs/07%20Interfaces/MCP%20Server%20Tool%20Catalog.md): the nine `kiln_*` tools
- [CLI](docs/07%20Interfaces/CLI%20%26%20REPL.md): `kiln sim`, `kiln game`, `kiln playbook`, `kiln deck`
